title: Decision matrix for the central bet (guide section 18B)
scale: 0 = absent or contrary, 1 = weak, 2 = adequate, 3 = strong; every score cites the evidence it rests on

criteria.fundamentality: Does it state a principle that applies beyond NeuroPixel?
criteria.current_evidence: Which audited results make it plausible?
criteria.falsifiability: Is there a concrete result, reachable within budget, that refutes it?
criteria.distance_to_antecedent: What do Hopfield, NCA, reservoirs or DEQ not already contain (section 18I)?
criteria.cost: Does it fit the shared RTX 3090, the queue and the available CPU?
criteria.external_dependency: Does it need a laboratory, data or evaluator from outside? (3 = none beyond the TEST custodian every candidate needs)
criteria.project_direction: Does it measure something CNNs and LLMs lack or pay dearly for: persistent memory, self-repair, continual learning?

C1.name: Repair-memory law and capacity against the information ceiling (sections 18C-18D)

fundamentality.evidence: Statement concerns any locally coupled cellular field with one shared rule; the contraction corollary (guide 18C) and the ceiling (18D) are substrate independent; G22 can test other substrates.

current_evidence.evidence: Deductive core only (18C; Boyd and Chua 1985; Jaeger 2001). Empirically weak or contrary: HT-11 (NeuroPixel 38/48 vs GRU 48/48, admission false), D-VIS07-02 (accuracy 94.357% at T8, 16.661% at T32; RMS 0.543 to 134,843), HT-14 (repair is assisted, not autonomous), H06-04 (damage training effects uncertain). ANT01-01 (equal state: global Hopfield repairs 85-95.5%, 3x3 local coupling fails from 4 patterns). MATH119-01 validates the information-ceiling machinery, not the hypothesis.

falsifiability.evidence: Registered stop rules (no measurable multistability; eta < 1% in all eligible cells; a comparator matching memory and repair at lower cost without qualitative difference) are each reachable with small fields and CPU (guide 18B).

distance_to_antecedent.evidence: Multistable memory is Hopfield (1982); fading memory is Boyd-Chua/Jaeger; neutral directions are Seung (1996). ANT01-01 shows locality adds no storage at equal state in the Hebbian case. Remaining distance: a learned local rule with hidden channels, and the prediction of the damage radius from basin geometry (P4).

cost.evidence: 8x8 fields, <= 8 state channels, CPU training of the reference field (completion_kit.stable_field, train_reference); ANT01 and MATH119 ran on CPU in minutes.

external_dependency.evidence: No laboratory or third-party data for P1-P4; external TEST custody (G17.1.ext) is common to all candidates; biological links (G21) are optional extensions.

project_direction.evidence: Persistent memory and self-repair are the capacities the guide prioritises (18B); Transformers do not offer them natively.

C2.name: Cost and energy law of local fields against competent comparators (sections 15, 18H)

fundamentality.evidence: Results are tied to one RTX 3090, its drivers and OpenGL/CUDA paths (G-R10-01, G-R11-01); a Landauer reference (18H) is general but the measured energies are many orders above it.

current_evidence.evidence: G-R10-01: compute path faster than best CUDA in 6/7 point comparisons (1.062-2.084x); G-R11-01: less board energy in 4/7 workloads, more in 3/7, overlapping ranges in 4/7; G-R08-01 slower in all seven.

falsifiability.evidence: Can fail, but outcomes depend on implementation tuning of both sides, so a refutation is easy to contest.

distance_to_antecedent.evidence: Cellular automata as convolutional networks (Gilpin 2019); shader-based execution of neural computation is established engineering.

cost.evidence: Needs repeated GPU-queue tickets; RENDER11 was stopped once by the 8 GiB RAM floor (G-R11-02).

external_dependency.evidence: Whole-system energy needs a wall meter or PSU instrumentation not present (G-R11-01 limits: CPU, RAM, PSU and wall energy unmeasured).

project_direction.evidence: Measures cost of computation CNNs already perform cheaply; not memory, repair or continual learning.

C3.name: Relational composition on hard tasks (section 10)
C3.eligibility_note: The guide admits this candidate only if G5 surpasses competence; G5 has not run and every external comparison so far is strongly negative.

fundamentality.evidence: Compositional binding is a general question.

current_evidence.evidence: H04-01 (-39.06 pp), H05-02 (-34.375 pp), HT-09 (-39.73 pp), HT-10 (-38.26 pp) against the relative Transformer; D-ROLE-01 joint flipped-query accuracy 0.5-7.5%; DEV04/GLOB05/READ03 gains are internal to NeuroPixel readouts.

distance_to_antecedent.evidence: The positive internal effect is query attention (D-DEV04-01, D-GLOB05-01), the Transformer mechanism itself.

cost.evidence: 8,192-16,384 update trainings per unit (D-QT-01, D-U16-01) through the GPU queue.

fundamentality.evidence: Continual-learning scenarios are general (van de Ven et al. 2022).

current_evidence.evidence: HT-12 preserves old tensors exactly by construction (native copies); H06-06 growth/routing reaches 25.651-26.335% binding; A06.1 growth trajectories establish no benefit (H06-01, H06-07).

falsifiability.evidence: Scenario-classified tests exist (van de Ven et al. 2022) but 'useful growth' needs an operational definition still missing.

distance_to_antecedent.evidence: Parameter isolation and expert growth are known (Kirkpatrick et al. 2017 and successors).

cost.evidence: Repeated trainings per stage; GPU queue.

project_direction.evidence: Continual learning is named in the project direction.

decision_rule: Highest total among eligible candidates; a tie or a lead that a single one-point change can overturn is resolved by project_direction then falsifiability, and reported as fragile.
